overview_description: Reusable UI building blocks and layout conventions shared across all Operon micro-apps. Use these standard components instead of building custom duplicates.
overview_guide_1: Use {'@'}operon-core/shadcn-ui primitives (Button, Card, Badge, Dialog, Sheet) for consistent styling and theme tokens.
overview_guide_2: Use the generic DataTable wrapper for searchable, filterable, paginated tables with CSV export and row selection.
overview_guide_3: Consume host notifications, auth, and active workspace via useKernel() instead of importing shell stores directly.
overview_card_datatable_desc: TanStack Table wrapper with faceted filters, column visibility, pagination, and Sheet inspector.
overview_card_primitives_desc: Accessible shadcn-vue components styled with Tailwind v4 semantic design tokens.
overview_card_overlays_desc: Standardized Dialog, Drawer/Sheet, and schema-driven forms from {'@'}operon-core/popup-ui & form-ui.
overview_card_kernel_desc: Cross-app toast events, auth identity, and local daemon bridge via {'@'}operon/kernel.
